regime.label: SEMI-LED RISK-ON REVERSAL -- MONDAY RAN BACKWARDS, AND QQQ GAPPED STRAIGHT INTO ITS 50-DAY AND WAS REJECTED TWICE
evidence: THE MIRROR: every leg of Monday's semi-led decline reversed overnight. AMD 473.625 (+3.70% vs 456.745), SMH 558.13 (+2.07%), TSM 418.609 (+2.07%), NVDA 212.25 (+1.81%), AVGO 362.78 (+1.12%), QQQ 712.43 (+0.87%), SPY 766.495 (+0.40%), TSLA 350.11 (+0.33%). MSFT 485.71 (-0.33%) is the LONE RED core name -- an exact inversion of Monday, when MSFT was the lone green one. All live 13:36:40Z.

MONDAY'S OPEN QUESTION IS ANSWERED, AND IT ANSWERED AGAINST THE BEARS -- BUT NOT THE WAY EITHER BRANCH PREDICTED. The 08-24 close block asked whether the MSFT-up / semis-down divergence would persist (making the QQQ short really a semis short in an index costume) or resolve with MSFT joining a falling tape (validating the index thesis). Neither happened: MSFT gave back its +1.14% AND the semis rejoined a RISING tape. This is a rotation back INTO semis, not a broad de-rating -- which is evidence against the bearish index premise rather than for it.

THE LEVEL IS THE WHOLE STORY. QQQ opened 711.23, ran to 713.13 in the first five minutes and to 713.11 in the second -- BOTH highs a tenth of a point under the 50-day MA at 713.2256 -- and closed the 13:35Z bar at 711.665. Two touches, two rejections, on FALLING volume (515,800 then 292,505). The 50-day that was support for three sessions and resistance since Monday is being tested from below in real time.

DISPERSION HAS COLLAPSED AND FLIPPED SIGN. Monday: QQQ -0.98% vs SPY -0.32%, a 66bp Nasdaq-specific de-rating. Today: QQQ +0.87% vs SPY +0.40%, a 47bp Nasdaq-specific RE-rating. The tape is trading the semiconductor complex in both directions, not the market.

VOL, own-measured this run on the 2026-09-25 board (31 DTE), call/put averaged: SPY 0.1293, QQQ 0.1962, NVDA 0.4071, AMD 0.5427, TSM 0.3467, AVGO 0.4974, MSFT 0.2605, TSLA 0.4105. SPY's put skew persists and is if anything wider (call 0.1205 vs put 0.1381) -- downside protection is still specifically bid even on a green open.

READ THE IV/RV PAIR, NOT THE HEADLINE -- SEVEN OF EIGHT NAMES FLIP. Raw ratios say cheap for MSFT 0.52, TSLA 0.70, AMD 0.74, TSM 0.90, QQQ 0.90; ex-gap they read 1.01, 1.16, 0.90, 1.26, 1.16. Only AMD is still under 1.0 ex-gap (0.899). This is the post-earnings-gap artifact CLAUDE.md documents by name, reproduced across the panel for a second consecutive session -- there is NO vol edge in buying core-list premium today, and no run may source a "premium is cheap" thesis from the raw column.
regime.implication: The tape has taken back Monday's move without resolving anything. QQQ is coiled between a 50-day it cannot clear (713.2256) and a shelf it has not lost (~708.5/706.3), with the largest scheduled variance event of the quarter -- NVDA -- 30 hours away. The correct posture is to hold the pre-measured levels and let the market pick a side. Both the bullish and the bearish trade today would be buying an index direction into a binary event in its heaviest weight, which is not a setup, it is a coin toss with theta attached.
